What We Carry

Women's Health product categories.

We maintain deep inventory across the core product types used in OB/GYN and women's health settings. Not sure if we carry what you need? Request a quote and we'll confirm availability.

Pregnancy Tests

Clinical-grade urine hCG pregnancy tests in bulk quantities. CLIA-waived options available. High-sensitivity formats for early detection.

  • Cassette format
  • Strip format
  • CLIA-waived
  • High-sensitivity (<20 mIU/mL)

Ovulation & Fertility Kits

LH surge detection and fertility diagnostic supplies for reproductive health and fertility clinics. Multi-test configurations available.

  • LH ovulation tests
  • Fertility combo kits (LH + hCG)
  • Cassette and strip formats
  • Bulk packaging

OB/GYN Consumables

Exam room supplies, collection kits, and procedural consumables for OB/GYN and women's health offices. Sourced for high-volume clinical environments.

  • Cervical swabs & collection kits
  • Exam room disposables
  • Specimen containers
  • Procedural supplies

Prenatal Vitamins & Supplements

Prenatal vitamin lines and OB-recommended supplement products at bulk pricing — ideal for clinics that dispense or resell directly to patients.

  • Prescription prenatal vitamins
  • OTC prenatal lines
  • DHA supplements
  • Folic acid formulations

Hormonal & Menopause Diagnostics

FSH, estrogen, and menopause-related rapid diagnostic kits for point-of-care hormone level screening in women's health settings.

  • FSH menopause tests
  • Hormonal panel kits
  • Rapid CLIA-waived formats
